# Clementine

> Clementine is a 100% client-side file converter. Images, audio, video,
> documents and subtitles are converted entirely in the browser using Canvas
> and FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly. No file is ever uploaded, and there is no
> server-side API.

Base URL: __SITE_URL__

## Agent instructions

- [instructions.md](__SITE_URL__/instructions.md): how to convert
  files with the in-page `window.clementine` scripting API (recommended) or by
  driving the UI with a headless browser. Includes a complete Playwright example.

### Scripting API

The page exposes `window.clementine`:

- `window.clementine.version` — API version string
- `window.clementine.categories()` — supported categories and formats
- `window.clementine.formats(fileName)` — valid output formats for a file
- `window.clementine.warmup()` — preload the audio/video engine
- `window.clementine.convertBase64({ base64, name, format })` — convert and
  return `{ name, mimeType, size, base64 }`

```js
await page.waitForFunction(() => !!window.clementine?.version);
const out = await page.evaluate(
  (i) => window.clementine.convertBase64(i),
  { base64, name: 'photo.jpg', format: 'png' },
);
```

There is no HTTP endpoint; use a headless browser (Playwright/Puppeteer) to run
the JavaScript API in the page.

## Supported conversions

- Images: `.jpg` `.jpeg` `.png` `.webp` `.gif` `.bmp` `.avif` → PNG, JPG, WEBP
- Audio: `.mp3` `.m4a` `.wav` `.flac` `.ogg` `.opus` `.aac` `.aiff` `.wma` →
  MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS
- Video: `.mp4` `.mov` `.mkv` `.webm` `.avi` `.wmv` → MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, GIF,
  MP3
- Documents: `.pdf` `.docx` `.txt` → TXT, PDF, PNG pages, JPG pages
- Subtitles: `.srt` `.vtt` → SRT, VTT, TXT

## Privacy

All processing happens locally in the browser. Files never leave the user's
device and no analytics or tracking are used.
